# Topology_Interconnect

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The arrangement of physical or logical links between processing nodes, defining communication paths and network structure. Topology interconnect determines data flow efficiency and resilience, directly influencing performance in both TCC and iNEST systems.
